steps.text: The Stage Editor! Here you place the objects of a stage around the characters.
The objects, from the back to the front. Move Up and Move Down change the order; New, Duplicate and Delete do what they say.
Click an object to select it and drag it to move it. CTRL+Z undoes a move. E/Q or the wheel zoom the camera.
Object: the image of the selected object, its animations, color, scale, scroll factor, opacity, angle and in which quality it shows up.
Data: where the characters stand, the camera offsets, the zoom, the camera speed and the style of the UI.
Meta: the characters shown to test it, the files to load first, and Save.
F1 shows every shortcut. Have fun building!
